Hi Katie / Tom —

Thanks again for carving out time today for the demo. Quick recap and next steps so we keep momentum on the procurement and security kickoff: 

1) Economic buyer & procurement path
- Can you confirm Tom is the owner for commercial approvals? If procurement has a separate PO owner please introduce them (email worked great in the demo).

2) Systems likely in-scope for the security review (please correct):
- Customer-facing web UI (session auth + SSO)
- Internal admin dashboard used by ClearWave ops
- Batch job that transforms clinical notes -> embeddings and stores to S3
- 3rd-party analytics (Mixpanel) that receives anonymized events

If anything above should be excluded from scope, flag it. Also call out any additional 3rd-party services (vendors) that will touch telemetry or PII.

3) Questionnaire & kickoff
- I can push our initial security questionnaire and a short runbook for the kickoff. Would you prefer we attach the form to this thread or share a short link?
- Proposed kickoff windows: Tue Jun 15 (10–11am ET) or Wed Jun 16 (2–3pm ET). If neither works, suggest times.

4) Procurement/contracting
- If you have a PO template or standard contract path, send it along. We can pre-load expected pricing and a draft SOW once we have a buyer + timeline.

I'll hold off on sending the questionnaire until you confirm scope and the procurement contact. Happy to jump on a 15-minute sync to land attendees.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Appreciate the recap. Quick answers:

- The admin dashboard is hosted in our VPC and uses our SSO (Okta).

Kickoff: Tue Jun 15 at 10am ET works for us. Please send a calendar invite.
